lines.zh: 贴着沙底一寸寸挪，像块会动的石头
lines.en: I shuffle along the sand like a walking stone.

lines.zh: 石头鱼摆尾，搅起一小团沙雾
lines.en: My tail stirs a small cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 海草擦过背脊，石头鱼继续低爬
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my back as I crawl low.

lines.zh: 珊瑚影下，石头鱼缓缓横移
lines.en: Under the coral shadow I drift sideways.

lines.zh: 别催，石头鱼本来就游不快
lines.en: No rush, stonefish were never built for speed.

lines.zh: 石头鱼伏低身子，假装只是礁石
lines.en: I flatten down and pretend to be reef rock.

lines.zh: 胸鳍拨水，石头鱼蹭过石缝
lines.en: My fins paddle me through a narrow rock gap.

lines.zh: 石头鱼挪到新沙坑，留下浅印
lines.en: I shift to a fresh hollow, leaving a faint print.

lines.zh: 水草床是我的路，慢慢走才稳
lines.en: The seagrass bed is my road, slow and steady.

lines.zh: 石头鱼缩着身子，从礁石边滑过
lines.en: I squeeze past the reef edge, body tucked in tight.

lines.zh: 石头鱼一颠一颠地挪，被水推着
lines.en: I bump along as if the water shoves me forward.

lines.zh: 珊瑚枝间，石头鱼只走最矮那道
lines.en: Among coral branches I take the lowest path.

lines.zh: 石头鱼停在沙沟里，先看有没有大家伙
lines.en: I pause in the sand trench, checking for big shapes.

lines.zh: 石头鱼往前蹭半尺，又贴着底不动
lines.en: I creep forward half a foot, then hug the bottom still.

lines.zh: 石头鱼沿着礁根往深处挪
lines.en: The stonefish creeps deeper along the reef's roots

lines.zh: 石头鱼把鳍收好，钻进阴影
lines.en: The stonefish folds its fins and slips into shadow

lines.zh: 石头鱼在沙上停一停，再挪
lines.en: The stonefish rests on the sand, then creeps on

lines.zh: 石头鱼擦过海绵，抖了一下
lines.en: The stonefish brushes a sponge and shudders

lines.zh: 石头鱼贴着沙，连鳃盖都懒得开
lines.en: I rest on the sand, barely opening my gills.

lines.zh: 我是一块石头，石头不必呼吸得太明显
lines.en: I am a stone; stones need not breathe loudly.

lines.zh: 伏在水底休息，等小鱼自己送上门
lines.en: Resting on the bottom, waiting for small fish to wander close.

lines.zh: 石头鱼数着海草摆动，数到七就困
lines.en: I count the swaying seagrass and doze by seven.

lines.zh: 礁石缝里最安全，我就在这儿发呆
lines.en: The reef crevice is safest, so here I stare at nothing.

lines.zh: 石头鱼把鳍收好，看起来像块卵石
lines.en: I tuck my fins in and look more like a pebble.

lines.zh: 水从头顶流过，我一动也不想动
lines.en: Water streams overhead and I refuse to move.

lines.zh: 石头鱼打个哈欠，沙子差点进嘴
lines.en: I yawn, and nearly swallow a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁这么吵，石头鱼只想安静
lines.en: The reef is loud; I only want quiet.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进沙里一半，剩一半当饵
lines.en: Half buried in sand, the rest of me is bait.

lines.zh: 石头鱼眯眼看水面，光斑晃得眼晕
lines.en: I squint at the surface, dizzy from shifting light.

lines.zh: 海草床午后很暖，石头鱼赖着不走
lines.en: The seagrass bed is warm; I refuse to leave.

lines.zh: 石头鱼动了一下，其实只是水流推的
lines.en: I moved, though it was only the current pushing.

lines.zh: 伏底休息是正事，别拿网兜来打扰
lines.en: Lying low is serious work; keep your net away.

lines.zh: 石头鱼盯着你，怀疑你踩坏了沙坑
lines.en: I stare at you, suspecting you crushed my sand hollow.

lines.zh: 你站那么高，石头鱼只好抬头看
lines.en: You stand so tall that I must look up.

lines.zh: 石头鱼认得你，上次也是这双靴子
lines.en: I know those boots; you stepped here before.

lines.zh: 别伸手，背上那些疙瘩不好摸
lines.en: Don't reach out; the lumps on my back are not for petting.

lines.zh: 石头鱼抬眼一瞬，又装作礁石
lines.en: I glance up once, then play reef rock again.

lines.zh: 你在珊瑚礁上找什么，石头鱼很好奇
lines.en: What are you hunting on the reef? I am curious.

lines.zh: 石头鱼看你半天，判断你不吃鱼
lines.en: I watch you a while and decide you don't eat fish.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住沙底，石头鱼缩了缩
lines.en: Your shadow covers the sand and I shrink a little.

lines.zh: 石头鱼歪头，鳍尖还在轻轻摆
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, fin tips still waving.

lines.zh: 这么大个影子，石头鱼先记下了
lines.en: Such a big shadow; I will remember it.

lines.zh: 石头鱼被打得翻身，肚皮朝上
lines.en: Hit hard, I flip over belly-up.

lines.zh: 疼，石头鱼硬归硬，也是肉做的
lines.en: It hurts; hard as I am, I'm still flesh.

lines.zh: 石头鱼缩进石缝，伤口蹭到沙子
lines.en: I shrink into a crevice, wound scraping sand.

lines.zh: 别打了，石头鱼才三点血
lines.en: Stop hitting; I only have three hearts.

lines.zh: 背上裂了道口子，海水刺得疼
lines.en: A gash opens on my back; the salt stings.

lines.zh: 石头鱼逃得很慢，逃跑也像在挪
lines.en: I flee slowly; even fleeing looks like crawling.

lines.zh: 这一下让石头鱼记你很久
lines.en: That blow will be remembered a long while.

lines.zh: 石头鱼喘着，鳃一张一合
lines.en: I gasp, gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 血流进沙里，石头鱼赶紧躲
lines.en: Blood seeps into sand; I hide quickly.

lines.zh: 石头鱼没力气再装石头了
lines.en: I am too weak to pretend to be a stone.

lines.zh: 有小鱼的味道，石头鱼喉咙动了动
lines.en: Something smells like small fish; my throat twitches.

lines.zh: 你把饵晃来晃去，石头鱼盯着不放
lines.en: You swing the bait and my eyes lock on.

lines.zh: 石头鱼想扑，可它更擅长等
lines.en: I want to lunge, but waiting is what I do best.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼再靠近一点，就一点
lines.en: Just a bit closer, little fish, just a bit.

lines.zh: 石头鱼咽口水，沙子也跟着动
lines.en: I swallow hard and the sand shifts with me.

lines.zh: 是吃的吗，石头鱼决定先信你
lines.en: Is that food? I decide to trust you once.

lines.zh: 饵在水里转圈，石头鱼也跟着转
lines.en: The bait circles in the water and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 石头鱼伏低，等小鱼游进射程
lines.en: I sink lower and wait for the fish to enter reach.

lines.zh: 闻到了，石头鱼整条鱼都精神
lines.en: I smell it, and every fin wakes up.

lines.zh: 别逗太久，石头鱼脾气和耐心都短
lines.en: Don't tease long; my patience is as short as I am.

lines.zh: 撞上了，石头鱼硬得像块真石头
lines.en: You bumped me; I am as hard as real stone.

lines.zh: 哎，鳍被挤扁了，让让路
lines.en: Hey, my fin is squashed, make some room.

lines.zh: 石头鱼被撞得滑进沙里，狼狈
lines.en: Knocked into the sand, I look ridiculous.

lines.zh: 你踢起的沙雾糊了石头鱼一脸
lines.en: The sand you kick up coats my whole face.

lines.zh: 石头鱼没躲开，本来就挪得慢
lines.en: I couldn't dodge; slow is my nature.

lines.zh: 礁石边太窄，两条命挤成一条
lines.en: The reef gap is narrow; two lives squeezed into one.

lines.zh: 石头鱼被顶得转了半圈，晕
lines.en: Spun half around by the shove, I am dizzy.

lines.zh: 撞我之前看看水底，我在这儿
lines.en: Look at the bottom before you walk; I am right here.

lines.zh: 石头鱼贴着你的腿滑过去，凉凉的
lines.en: I slide past your leg, cold and gritty.

lines.zh: 这不叫攻击，这叫石头鱼没长眼睛
lines.en: This isn't an attack; stonefish just lack good eyes.

lines.zh: 石头鱼找个石缝，想把卵藏进去
lines.en: I look for a rock crevice to hide my eggs in.

lines.zh: 别看我，求偶也要挑块好石头
lines.en: Don't stare; even courting needs a good stone.

lines.zh: 两条石头鱼并排趴着，谁也不说话
lines.en: Two stonefish lie side by side, saying nothing.

lines.zh: 石头鱼的鳍碰了碰对方，就算答应
lines.en: My fin brushes theirs, and that counts as yes.

lines.zh: 海草床这块地不错，适合养小鱼
lines.en: This seagrass patch is good ground to raise fry.

lines.zh: 石头鱼围着小石堆打转，算献殷勤
lines.en: I circle a small rock pile as a courtship gift.

lines.zh: 繁殖季到了，石头鱼也得挪身子
lines.en: Breeding season is here; even I must move.

lines.zh: 石头鱼把最美的卵石让给伴侣
lines.en: I give my prettiest pebble to my mate.

lines.zh: 两只石头鱼挤在珊瑚影里，安静地等
lines.en: Two stonefish wait quietly in coral shadow.

lines.zh: 石头鱼答应得很慢，像它游得一样慢
lines.en: I say yes slowly, as slowly as I swim.

lines.zh: 石头鱼叼起一颗卵石，藏在鳃下
lines.en: I pick up a pebble and hide it under my gill.

lines.zh: 这片贝壳归我了，别抢
lines.en: This shell is mine now, hands off.

lines.zh: 石头鱼把小石子垒成堆，当窝用
lines.en: I stack small stones into a pile as a nest.

lines.zh: 海草碎片含在嘴里，像叼着草
lines.en: A seagrass scrap sits in my mouth like a straw.

lines.zh: 石头鱼捡到亮片，整条鱼都得意
lines.en: I found something shiny and I am very proud.

lines.zh: 东西掉在沙上，石头鱼慢慢挪过去
lines.en: Something dropped on the sand; I inch toward it.

lines.zh: 石头鱼用嘴拱石子，藏不住就咽了
lines.en: I nudge a stone up and swallow it when hiding fails.

lines.zh: 这块珊瑚碎得正好，石头鱼收下
lines.en: This coral chip is just right; I will keep it.

lines.zh: 石头鱼背着家当走，三步歇一步
lines.en: I carry my hoard three steps, then rest.

lines.zh: 别踢水，石头鱼正叼着东西呢
lines.en: Don't splash; I'm carrying something.

lines.zh: 小鱼游过来了，石头鱼锁定目标
lines.en: A small fish approaches; I lock on.

lines.zh: 石头鱼瞳孔一缩，沙底顿时安静
lines.en: My eyes narrow and the sandbed goes quiet.

lines.zh: 那团小影子是我的，谁都别动
lines.en: That little shadow is mine; nobody move.

lines.zh: 石头鱼把身子压低，嘴对准前方
lines.en: I press down and aim my mouth forward.

lines.zh: 目标很小，但石头鱼正好也小
lines.en: The target is small, and so am I.

lines.zh: 石头鱼开始倒数，等小鱼过第三道海草
lines.en: I count down until the fish passes the third seagrass blade.

lines.zh: 锁定那只小虾，石头鱼鳍都僵了
lines.en: Locked on that little shrimp, even my fins freeze.

lines.zh: 大鱼来了就跑，小鱼来了就等
lines.en: Big fish means flee; small fish means wait.

lines.zh: 石头鱼盯得太久，猎物先发现它
lines.en: I stared too long; the prey spotted me first.

lines.zh: 这顿有着落了，石头鱼心想
lines.en: This meal is settled, I think to myself.

lines.zh: 石头鱼贴着底追，沙子一路翻
lines.en: I chase along the bottom, sand churning behind.

lines.zh: 别跑，石头鱼追得慢但很有耐心
lines.en: Don't run; I chase slowly but patiently.

lines.zh: 小虾钻进石缝，石头鱼在外面守
lines.en: The shrimp ducks into a crevice; I wait outside.

lines.zh: 石头鱼加速了，虽然看着没动
lines.en: I speed up, though it hardly looks like it.

lines.zh: 目标拐弯，石头鱼笨拙地跟着拐
lines.en: The target turns and I turn, clumsily.

lines.zh: 石头鱼的影子先到，鱼才到
lines.en: My shadow arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 追到海草丛边，石头鱼迟疑了一下
lines.en: At the seagrass edge I hesitate.

lines.zh: 石头鱼张嘴冲，像块石头撞过来
lines.en: Mouth open, I charge like tumbling rock.

lines.zh: 别往珊瑚里躲，石头鱼进不去
lines.en: Don't hide in the coral; I can't fit.

lines.zh: 石头鱼追累了，先趴下喘口气
lines.en: Tired of chasing, I flop down to breathe.

lines.zh: 石头鱼撞上去，硬壳顶得猎物翻白
lines.en: I ram it, my hard body flipping the prey over.

lines.zh: 一口咬住，石头鱼的牙细但很密
lines.en: I bite down; my teeth are fine but many.

lines.zh: 背上疙瘩硌得它直扭，石头鱼不松口
lines.en: My rough back makes it squirm; I don't let go.

lines.zh: 石头鱼整个压上去，靠体重赢
lines.en: I drop my whole body on it and win by weight.

lines.zh: 这一撞不算漂亮，但很管用
lines.en: The hit isn't elegant, but it works.

lines.zh: 石头鱼甩头，把小虾摔在沙上
lines.en: I snap my head and slam the shrimp into sand.

lines.zh: 别怪我，礁上的规矩是小的先吃
lines.en: Don't blame me; on the reef, the small eat first.

lines.zh: 石头鱼咬完就退，怕引来大鱼
lines.en: I bite and retreat before big fish notice.

lines.zh: 疼吗，石头鱼自己撞得也疼
lines.en: Does it hurt? My own head hurts too.

lines.zh: 石头鱼嘴小，只能一口一口来
lines.en: My mouth is small; I take it bite by bite.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁的水一晃，石头鱼出现了
lines.en: The reef water shimmers and I appear.

lines.zh: 沙底多了块石头，其实是我
lines.en: The sand gains a stone, and that stone is me.

lines.zh: 石头鱼从石缝里钻出，带着一身沙
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crevice, coated in sand.

lines.zh: 这窝只来了两只，我和它的伴
lines.en: Only two of us this spawn, me and my companion.

lines.zh: 海草床新住户报到，我是石头鱼
lines.en: New tenant on the seagrass bed: stonefish.

lines.zh: 石头鱼第一次伏底，姿势就很熟练
lines.en: First time lying low, and already a natural.

lines.zh: 水里冒出一小团沙，石头鱼出生
lines.en: A puff of sand, and stonefish is born.

lines.zh: 石头鱼睁眼先看礁石，记路
lines.en: I open my eyes on the reef and memorize the paths.

lines.zh: 别踩，我刚生成还没站稳
lines.en: Don't step there; I just spawned and haven't settled.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁又热闹一点，我来了
lines.en: The reef got one shade livelier; I'm here.

lines.zh: 水都烧热了，石头鱼烫得直跳
lines.en: The water boils and I leap from the heat.

lines.zh: 从高处摔进沙里，石头鱼散了架
lines.en: Dropped from above, I land in sand, half stunned.

lines.zh: 石头鱼也会呛水，别不信
lines.en: Stonefish can choke on water too, believe it.

lines.zh: 一股冲击把石头鱼掀出沙坑
lines.en: A blast throws me clean out of my hollow.

lines.zh: 箭擦过背鳍，石头鱼抖了一下
lines.en: An arrow grazes my dorsal fin and I flinch.

lines.zh: 药水味道古怪，石头鱼鳞片发麻
lines.en: That potion tastes odd; my scales go numb.

lines.zh: 饿到眼花，石头鱼把石子当小鱼
lines.en: Starving, I mistake pebbles for small fish.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，石头鱼浑身一颤
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and I shudder all over.

lines.zh: 掉出世界，石头鱼的沙底不见了
lines.en: Falling out of the world, my sandbed is gone.
